html:
G'oya

Eng so'nggi buyurtma shunday buyurtmaki, shu mijozda undan keyin boshqa buyurtma yo'q. "Undan keyingi" buyurtmani LEFT JOIN bilan qidiramiz va topilmaganlarini qoldiramiz. "Keyin" degani: sanasi kattaroq, yoki sanasi teng, lekin id si kattaroq.

Yechim

SELECT c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN orders newer
  ON newer.customer_id = o.customer_id
 AND (newer.order_date > o.order_date
      OR (newer.order_date = o.order_date AND newer.id > o.id))
WHERE newer.id IS NULL

newer har bir buyurtmaga shu mijozning undan yangiroq buyurtmalarini ulaydi. newer.id IS NULL bo'lsa, yangirog'i topilmagan, demak bu oxirgisi. Buyurtmasiz mijoz birinchi JOIN dayoq tushib qoladi.

Namunada Dilnozaning ikkala buyurtmasi 20-fevralda. 3-buyurtmaning yangirog'i bor (5-buyurtma: sana teng, id katta), 5-buyurtmaniki yo'q, natijada u qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

Eng katta id ni olish. id buyurtma bazaga kiritilgan tartib, sanalar tartibi emas. Namunada Azizning eng katta id li buyurtmasi 4-buyurtma (1-fevral), eng so'nggisi esa 2-buyurtma (5-mart):

Noto'g'riSELECT c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM orders x WHERE x.customer_id = c.id)

Faqat MAX(order_date) bilan solishtirish. Bir kunda ikki buyurtma bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham chiqadi: namunada Dilnoza ikki marta.

Boshqa yo'l

Oyna funksiyasi bilan: har bir mijozning buyurtmalarini yangidan eskiga raqamlab, birinchisini olamiz.

SELECT name, id AS order_id, amount
FROM (
  SELECT c.name, o.id, o.amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id
                            ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
) t
WHERE rn = 1
